name: SaaS Trust Center, SOC 2 & AI Subprocessor Risk Monitor to Slack, Gmail & Sheets

parameters.content:
## SaaS Trust Center, SOC 2 & AI Subprocessor Monitor (Zero-Proxy TPRM)

Monitors vendor Trust Centers (Vanta, SafeBase, Drata), SOC 2 / ISO 27001 certifications, DNS IAM/SSO records, and AI subprocessors (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, etc.) on a weekly schedule. Filters out zero-cost baselines, scores vendor risk (`HIGH_RISK`, `COMPLIANCE_CHANGE`, `AUDIT_INFO`), logs every change to Google Sheets, and escalates AI subprocessor alerts to `#security-alerts` + Gmail.

**Actor URL:** https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/saas-trust-center-soc2-monitor
**GitHub MCP & Kit:** https://github.com/wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
**Cost:** $5.00 / 1,000 domains audited · **$0 on baseline or unchanged monitor runs** · 128–256 MB RAM · $0 proxy.

### 1. Vendor Inventory Input (Google Sheets -> Batch Payload)

Create a spreadsheet with two tabs:
- **`Vendors`**: columns `domain` (e.g. `apify.com`, `linear.app`, `canva.com`), optional `mode` (`monitor` or `audit`).
- **`ComplianceLog`**: columns `timestamp`, `severity`, `recordType`, `eventType`, `domain`, `trustCenterPlatform`, `trustCenterUrl`, `certifications`, `hasAiSubprocessor`, `aiSubprocessors`, `iamProviders`, `previousValue`, `newValue`, `confidence`.

Connect your Google Sheets OAuth credential to both Google Sheets nodes.

### 2. Zero-Proxy Trust Center & DNS Audit

1. Create a free [Apify account](https://apify.com) and generate an API token (`Settings -> API & Integrations`).
2. Create an n8n **Header Auth** credential (`Name`: `Authorization`, `Value`: `Bearer <your_apify_token>`) and attach it to **Run SaaS Trust Center Monitor**.
3. Baseline snapshots (`baseline_initialized`) are filtered out automatically so Slack is never spammed.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - 2. Zero-Proxy Trust Center & DNS Audit

parameters.content:
### 3. Risk Tiering, Escalation & Audit Trail

- **All actionable events** are appended to `ComplianceLog` in Google Sheets.
- **HIGH_RISK** (AI subprocessor detected/added or certification/trust center removal) -> Slack `#security-alerts` + Gmail escalation.
- **COMPLIANCE_CHANGE** & **AUDIT_INFO** -> Slack `#vendor-compliance`.
